topics.headline: Oil rebound points to higher US CPI, but Eurozone rise less certain
topics.summary: With Brent surging from under $70 to above $85 post-ceasefire collapse and gasoline prices already rising, expert consensus points to a US headline CPI rebound in July; but Eurozone HICP needs simultaneous reversals across Germany, France, Italy and Spain, making a joint US-Eurozone acceleration plausible but not assured.

topics.headline: HY spreads near cycle tights at 2.69%, asymmetric widening risk builds
topics.summary: HY OAS sits near multi-year lows (2.69-2.84%) versus a 4.9% long-term average, kept compressed by record issuance and inflows even as CCC-vs-B dispersion widens and analysts warn of complacency; near-term odds favor stability to modest widening rather than continued compression.

topics.headline: Bitcoin ETFs ride three-day inflow streak, but momentum remains fragile
topics.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs pulled in roughly $368 million over three straight sessions (Jul 22-24 range), continuing a whipsaw pattern of sharp inflow/outflow reversals seen all month; with YTD outflows still at $5.8 billion and analysts split on whether this marks a bottom, near-term net inflows look plausible but far from assured.

topics.headline: Hyperscaler power deals hit near-weekly cadence across gas, nuclear, renewables
topics.summary: Multi-gigawatt PPAs and co-located generation deals (Microsoft/Chevron, Meta nuclear trio, Google/Intersect) have become routine monthly occurrences in 2026, making another announcement within 30 days highly likely given regulatory, market, and competitive pressures all pointing the same direction.
